prompts.background: Use case photorealistic-natural. ONE high-resolution photographic landscape, wide 3:2 canvas matching a 1920x1248 desktop scene composition. Calm first-person human eye level, fixed natural 35mm lens, level horizon. Soft natural illumination, realistic texture, moderate contrast and saturation, no HDR, no fantasy glow. A continuous believable space with a clearly visible route from bottom center toward a stopping place near x=50%, y=48%. This is a BACKGROUND PLATE for later multi-plane FFmpeg camera parallax: keep the central view open, do not include large close framing objects at the edges since these are separate layers. The image must fill every edge with scenery. No people, bodies, animals, signs, buildings, text, logos, watermarks, collage or panels. Snowy mountain landscape: unmistakable distant jagged SNOW-COVERED peaks, powder snow on gentle terrain, a few distant conifers at mid distance, blue-white morning shade and gentle warm morning light from upper LEFT. A shallow snow path leads from bottom center toward a FLAT snow viewpoint. Snow texture and subtle contours readable, not white blown out. No storm, no falling flakes, no ski resort, no dramatic cliff, no close branches.
